evidence.claim: Current episode distinguishes inherited/trained/acquired sources and temporary hand conditions; inheritance origin is a label, not a species/genealogy/evolution engine.
Generic body effect writes a scalar body property. Authored predicates can use facts; this does not itself implement temporary-form restoration or carrier-aware physiology.
Read snapshots identify forms, functions, pools and independent condition owners; this is reusable support information.
Organ/cost/carrier foundations are already planned. Extend selected functional changes rather than redo the transplant audit.

findings.proposed_player_behavior: An actor changes form or achieves selected structural growth, gains the supported verbs and loses only incompatible execution while retaining learned information. A temporary overlay, injury and lasting change restore differently. Species/ancestry, acquired hereditary potential and actual descendant support remain separate.

findings.title: Acquisition and synthesis should settle explicit output kinds and real donor/constituent outcomes

evidence.claim: Source/faculty grant, suppression and development are separate from executable power ownership.

Power learn/copy/transfer/remove/fragment/refine exist; copy can include mastery, transfer clears donor power ownership, fusion consumes constituent owned flags. These do not by themselves move source/body/item owners.
Hybrid checks lineage and retained constituent ownership except in explicit fusion; it does not prove a new constituent source/body function was synthesized.
Acquired sources may legitimately supply intrinsic guidance instead of a learned method.
Observation, reconstruction, temporary imitation and transfer already have different proposed outputs, including real superior copying.
MOL-C089-04: life-force integration can convey base-creature instinctive understanding and potential inherited faculty; ordinary enhancement does not convey the same instinctive affinity.
evidence.verification: direct supplied paragraphs read; narration distinguishes procedures and their specific risks

findings.current_player_behavior: Useful generic acquisition effects mutate power ownership/mastery/fragments and source faculties. Authors can combine effects and execution predicates. No generic transaction classification establishes a taught record versus temporary supplied execution versus conserved source transfer or created organism.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: A taught or reconstructed method yields learning/evidence; a temporary imitation or loan grants exactly its selected execution and termination; theft/transfer changes the actual source/custody and donor support; fusion consumes only declared inputs and creates its selected new function. Inherited/created faculties receive genuine support and source-provided control where applicable.

findings.title: Maintained channels, permanent anchors and suppression require dependency-aware continuation

evidence.claim: Learn stores a policy; recover fills reserve/cools strain; use pays conversion with output/control/strain checks. This preserves independent dimensions but does not derive body/source modifiers or continuous upkeep automatically.
Conditions store expiry/onTick; faculty suppression toggles suppression without deleting ownership. Generic suppression does not automatically reconcile separate jobs/conditions.
completeJob applies frozen effects without general continuation/support revalidation.
Jobs settle before condition expiration/ticks. This concrete ordering must be reconciled for a selected channel/expiry boundary, not silently generalized.
Independent upkeep, recovery, capacity, startup/use and strain channels are already covered; do not repeat or stack original hypotheses as canon.
MOL-C089-04 and MOL-C092-01: a reserve anchor ties up capacity; losing the old body/life-force anchor unravels the enhancement. One simulacrum continually stabilizes usable reserves.
OE16: environmental replenishment and Soul Weave can balance sustain for some avatars indefinitely. OE07: missing True Name prevents Shadow Bond's condition without deleting the held faculty.
evidence.verification: direct supplied paragraphs read; bound to Sunny's stage and focal account

findings.current_player_behavior: Paid frozen jobs, condition ticks, reserve recovery and faculty suppression operate as distinct mechanisms. Current inspected generic paths do not automatically terminate an effect when its live support disappears or restore only the same dependent continuation.
findings.proposed_player_behavior: A supported channel starts, sustains and ends against its actual source/body/pool/target/clock. Capacity anchoring differs from fuel spent per minute. Suppression, missing identity key, removal, service loss and exhaustion have distinct outcomes. Restoration returns eligible execution without regranting ownership or undoing paid aftermath.

Selected boundary ordering, interruption, escrow and clock policy

Strong force can defeat an ordinary obstacle; neither family tags nor relative ranks manufacture immunity or mandatory tradeoffs.
